description: Text-audio foundation model from Boson AI

summary.one_liner: Higgs Audio repository from Boson AI whose README says the v3 text-to-speech model is now standalone and points users to hosted API or Hugging Face weights, with v2/v2.5 docs moved to README_V2.md.
summary.what_it_does: The README states that Higgs Audio v3 is a standalone release that does not depend on this repository, so cloning it is unnecessary for the latest model. It directs users to the Boson AI hosted API (OpenAI-compatible, with preset voices, zero-shot voice cloning, and streaming) and to open weights at bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b on Hugging Face. Self-hosting is recommended via SGLang-Omni using an sgl-omni serve command. The v3 model is described as conversational TTS across 100+ languages with inline emotion, style, and prosody control. Full installation, examples, and benchmarks for v2 and v2.5 are in README_V2.md, which this README points to. The README itself contains little installation detail for this repo.
how_to_run: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BOSON_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model": "higgs-audio-v3-tts", "input": "Hello, this is a test."}' --output out.mp3
notable: Higgs Audio v3 is a standalone release; the repo itself is largely a pointer to hosted API and weights
OpenAI-compatible hosted API with preset voices, zero-shot cloning, and streaming
Conversational TTS across 100+ languages with inline emotion, style, and prosody control
Open weights for the 4B model are on Hugging Face
caveats: Commercial production, hosted, or revenue-generating use requires a separate commercial license
The hosted API is a free, rate-limited public preview
Full v2 / v2.5 documentation has moved to README_V2.md, not in this README
